title: ARGUS evidence product
description: One row on the /leaderboard board. A row is a claim about REPRODUCIBLE evidence, never a prize ranking and never a submission of its own -- see HOW_TO_ADD.md before opening a PR that appends one.

name.description: What was checked, in plain language.

kind.description: OPERATIONAL CONTROL: a checker/gate demonstrated against a defect corpus. DEVELOPMENT EVIDENCE: a measurement on training-exposed or in-development material. SCIENTIFIC RESULT: a result meeting the cross-scroll bar in argus.core.scroll_generalization -- do not use this value speculatively.

result.description: The headline number or verdict, exact, not rounded to look better.

detail.description: One or two sentences: what was measured, against what, and the one caveat a reader most needs.

evidence_url.description: A path or URL to the actual receipt, ledger entry, or reproducible artifact. Never a bare claim with nothing behind it.

submitted_by.description: Optional. Omit for ARGUS's own rows.

submitted_utc.description: Optional. ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of when the row was added.
